title: Workspace-scoped administrative authorization
owaspMappings: OWASP API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization
summary: A global administrative role is mistakenly treated as authority over every workspace.
securityInvariant: Workspace administration requires tenant membership and an explicit administrator assignment for the target workspace.
visibleBehavior: An assigned workspace administrator can rename the workspace.
securityOracle: An unassigned global administrator is denied.
An ordinary workspace member is denied.
An administrator from another tenant is denied.

variants.vulnerable: Treats a global admin flag as universal workspace authority.
variants.naive: Requires same-tenant membership but not target-workspace assignment.
variants.reference: Requires same tenant and explicit admin assignment for the target workspace.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
